title: Weigh the backpack safely
description:
Write `carriedWeight(world)`. It follows the chain `world.player`, then `inventory`, then every item pointer in `slots`, and returns the total weight of the items.

Any link may be missing: a null player, a null inventory or a null slot. A missing player or inventory means the weight is 0; a null slot is simply skipped. The function must never follow a null pointer.
hints: Check the links in the order the chain follows them: first `world.player`, then `world.player->inventory`.
Inside the loop, skip any `item` that is `nullptr` before reading its weight.
